ratios.facility: Amended and Restated Credit Agreement (Wells Fargo Bank, N.A., as administrative agent)
ratios.quote: At December 31, 2025, our consolidated total leverage ratio was 3.68 to 1.00 as compared to a covenant maximum of 4.00 to 1.00 under the Credit Agreement.

ratios.facility: Amended and Restated Credit Agreement (Wells Fargo Bank, N.A., as administrative agent)
ratios.quote: At December 31, 2025, our consolidated interest coverage ratio was 5.47 to 1.00 as compared to a covenant minimum of 3.00 to 1.00 under the Credit Agreement.

parsed.notes: The base leverage maximum is 3.50x. It steps up to 4.00x for the four quarters after a qualifying acquisition, and the July 1, 2025 Accu-Fab acquisition qualified, so 4.00x applied at 12/31/2025. The February 25, 2026 amendment came after the period end. It lowers the minimum interest coverage to 2.75x through Q4 2026. It raises the maximum leverage to 5.25x for Q1-Q2 2026, 5.00x for Q3 2026 and 4.00x for Q4 2026, then 3.50x from 2027. It also cuts revolver commitments to $275,000 from $350,000. The company says it was in compliance at 12/31/2024, but no ratios are given for that date. Interest margins tied to the leverage ratio are pricing terms, not covenants, and are excluded.
